visual_description: Weld droops on top and underneath or falls through entirely, making a hole.

possible_causes_and_solutions.solution: Reduce current.
Increase welding speed and ensure that welding speed is kept steady.

defect_name: Stick Weld Penetration (Workpiece Heat Control) - INADEQUATE PENETRATION
visual_description: Weld does not contact the joint fully, just on the surface.

possible_causes_and_solutions.solution: Keep arc on leading edge of weld puddle. Hold torch at proper angles.
Slow down so fill material has time to melt into the weld location. Increase current.
Bevel thick workpieces, allow slight gap, and weld in several passes.
Increase amount of fill material.

Clamp workpieces securely. Make tack welds to hold workpieces.
